Unitree's newest robot is a dog on wheels
caption:
Unitree's new robot dog doesn't walk — it rolls on wheels. It's a big change from the four-legged machines the company is famous for.

Wheels mean more speed on flat ground. Legs handle rough terrain. A robot that can do both could be way more practical for real jobs — think deliveries, patrols, or warehouse work.
